From what I recall, it was released in 2002 by Amigo Spiele. There was also a reprint in 2003 by Days of Wonder with a new design. So, the original release year is 2002, and the English edition came out in 2003.

Now, moving on to Catan, which is also a well-known board game. I believe it was created by Klaus Teuber and first published in Germany in 1995 by Kosmos under the name Die Siedler von Catan. The English edition followed in 1996 by Mayfair Games. So, the original release year for Catan is 1995, with the English version coming out the next year.

This 2015 release is a significant update, but it's a rebranding rather than a new original publication. Pirate's Cove, on the other hand, had a reprint in 2003, but that's still older than the 2015 Catan edition.
